instruction: Update the title color on slide one to blue

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title color of the first slide from red (FF0000) to blue (0000FF). The evaluator checks if the title text color matches blue with a tolerance of 20 to account for slight variations in blue shades. The custom getter extracts the RGB color from the title text, and the custom metric compares it against the expected blue color with tolerance for fuzzy matching.
